prompt: Create ONE transparent PNG sprite animation strip, exactly THREE equal square cells horizontally (3 columns, 1 row). ADVANCE tactical movement effect, designed to pair with retreat. Flat front-facing pixel art battle overlay inspired by early handheld RPG battle effects. White/pearl/cool steel gray ONLY, chunky crisp pixel clusters, no blue or gold. Frame1 one hollow right-pointing chevron with a short horizontal speed dash trailing to its LEFT; frame2 two separated hollow right-pointing chevrons with two short motion streaks trailing to LEFT; frame3 three small fading horizontal dashes and tiny residual chevron tip on right. Generous transparent gutters and margin. Three phases onset, peak, fade, same scale and shared center. No character, background, floor, perspective tilt, weapons, labels, text, checkerboard or glow. This is an independent composable sprite layer for an actor moving forward. Wider than tall effect occupying about half of each square cell. Exactly one row of three frames. Output wide 3:1 transparent canvas.
